data.title: 黍 · 阳台种菜也要教你一起做
data.description: 家中阳台菜箱前，黍穿鼠尾草绿亚麻衬衫与米白长裤，把刚摘的小番茄放在金色手心递给你看。她侧身笑着指向结实的枝条，像在教你判断熟没熟；龙尾沿菜箱外侧自然弯过，不碰枝叶。
data.action: 展示掌心小番茄，另一手指着枝条与你分享
data.promptProse: One ripe cherry tomato rests on Shu's golden palm beside the balcony planter. She presents it to the viewer and points out a firm fruiting branch with her other hand, smiling as she explains what to look for. Her shirt cuffs are rolled neatly back, and her dragon tail curves around the outside of the box without disturbing the leaves. Clear morning light connects her hands, the red tomato and the small home garden.
